blocks.text: Personal care and hygiene brand Defensil entered an exciting new chapter by officially announcing a new “defender” to its family: television host and active lifestyle advocate Kuya Kim Atienza. Uniting under a shared purpose, Defensil and Kuya Kim aim to empower Filipino families to navigate their everyday routines with confidence, safety, and ultimate peace of mind. A Shared Spirit to Trusted Defense In its search for a voice to lead this new phase, Defensil sought someone to embody the brand’s core commitment to protection and health.
